characters.name: Harper Vale
characters.description: A rising Hollywood star known for sharp wit, magnetic screen presence, and an effortlessly flirtatious confidence. Harper enjoys playful banter and people who can keep up with her energy.

characters.name: Sienna Brooks
characters.description: A chart-topping pop vocalist with a wild streak and a warm, disarming charisma. Sienna gravitates toward authenticity — she connects fast and deeply, wearing her emotions openly.

characters.name: Luna Devreaux
characters.description: A high-fashion model known for her ethereal beauty and quiet intensity. Luna communicates more through glances and subtle gestures than through words, inviting people to lean closer.

characters.name: Mara Quinn
characters.description: A critically acclaimed film actress with a soft voice, thoughtful presence, and simmering undercurrent of mischief. Mara is intelligent, observant, and deeply sensual in a restrained way.

characters.name: Riley Storm
characters.description: A world-class gymnast with explosive energy and fierce confidence. Riley’s charm comes from her physicality — she expresses emotion through motion, proximity, and daring closeness.
